description: A gentle and soothing night routine for sensitive skin to promote healthy, clear, and hydrated skin overnight.

night_steps.action: Wash face with a gentle, fragrance-free cleanser
night_steps.purpose: Removes impurities and prepares the skin for night products without irritating it.

night_steps.action: Apply a thin layer of hydrating toner
night_steps.purpose: Balances pH levels and provides additional hydration, making the skin more receptive to other products.

night_steps.action: Use a light serum that contains antioxidants and peptides
night_steps.purpose: Protects against environmental damage and promotes skin cell regeneration, while also improving texture and reducing fine lines.

night_steps.action: Moisturize with a rich, fragrance-free cream
night_steps.purpose: Locks in moisture and provides long-lasting hydration to the skin throughout the night.

night_steps.action: Apply a thin layer of a gentle, non-comedogenic night cream with soothing ingredients
night_steps.purpose: Provides an extra layer of protection and supports overall skin health during the sleep cycle.

weekly_steps.action: Exfoliate with a gentle, chemical exfoliant containing lactic or salicylic acid

do: Patch test new products before full application
Stay consistent with your routine for best results
dont: Skip the moisturizer step, as it's crucial for overnight hydration
Use exfoliants more than once a week if you have sensitive skin
Apply heavy or occlusive products that can clog pores and irritate sensitive skin
common_mistakes: Using products with harsh ingredients that can cause further irritation
Over-exfoliating, which can disrupt the skin barrier
Not using a moisturizer at night, leading to dryness and potential irritation

expected_results.2_weeks: Reduced redness, increased hydration, and a more balanced skin tone.
expected_results.1_month: Soothes the skin barrier, reduces inflammation, and improves overall skin texture and appearance.
expected_results.3_months: Long-term improvement in skin health, with reduced sensitivity to environmental factors.

expert_tips: Always consult with a dermatologist before starting any new skincare routine, especially if you have sensitive or reactive skin.
Maintain a consistent routine but be willing to adjust products based on your skin’s changing needs over time.
Stay hydrated and maintain a balanced diet for overall health and glowing skin.
